SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 5.1.2 Speaking fluency, part of Strand 1 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How can we display good manners as we communicate with others? 2. Why is it important to observe etiquette in communication?
